      <div class="tile-title" role="heading" aria-level="2">Re-reading the ACC bibliography</div>
      <p>A rebuild of my 2020 study of Paul R. Goldin's <i>Ancient Chinese Civilization</i> bibliography, using the 2019 and 2026 editions. A new parser and a full check of every entry feed a multilingual embedding model that measures how the subject matter of titles shifts from decade to decade. The shifts are small but consistent from about 1980, and part of the apparent 1970s change turns out to be the switch from Wade-Giles to pinyin.</p>
